messages:
Anya: Quick scan from the 13B-int6 bring-up. Ran evals across chat, summarization, and intent classification. High-level: ~25% token-cost reduction vs our 13B-int8 baseline, ~8-12% relative quality delta on helpfulness depending on task, p95 latency up ~10-15% in small-batch scenarios. Mini-scorecard below. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Anya: ```mini-scorecard (2k eval samples, weighted by product mix)
Model        | cost_rel | avg_macro_f1 | p95_latency | notable_regressions
13B-int8(b)  | 1.00     | 0.912        | 220ms       | none major
13B-int6     | 0.75     | 0.835        | 245ms       | small hallucination set + style drift on summarization
14B-int8     | 1.35     | 0.925        | 260ms       | none
Notes: sample set skewed to summarization/search. Numbers = median across seeds.
```

Tom: How big was the eval set per task and what do you think product impact will be? Can we safely route chat->int6?

Anya: Eval set ~2k total (chat 900, summarization 600, classification 500). Product impact estimate: expect ~0.5-1.0% absolute QA accuracy drop on chat-style factual answer tasks, bigger for tight summarization fidelity. For casual chat features it's probably acceptable; for any SLA-critical path we should keep int8 fallback.

Devon: Can you paste 3-5 concrete prompts that regressed so we can add to the guardrail repro set?

Anya: sure — quick examples that showed hallucination/style shifts:
- "Summarize the legal requirements for remote work in Germany." -> hallucinated statute names
- "Given this convo, extract the user's billing id." -> occasional wrong field mapping
- "Condense this technical doc into 3 bullets for execs." -> omitted a key risk paragraph

Lee: infra notes: if we flip traffic to int6 we should disable "burst routing" by default and keep conservative batch_max_tokens=2048 for first wave. Continuous batching + KV-cache warm starts reduces p95 a lot; recommend enabling prefix caching on warmup layers. Also need to ensure model quant profile is pinned in deploy config to avoid drift across hosts.

Sara: Rollout proposal: canary 2% live traffic -> monitor eval score on the repro set + product KPIs. Auto-fallback policy: if repro-score drops >5% absolute OR latency p95 worsens >15% for 10m, revert traffic. Add a small synthetic probe set every 5m.

Tom: Quick pricing math for GTM: if current monthly token spend ~= $120k, 25% unit savings -> ~$30k/mo. Good to cite for sales. Also flag margin impact on free-tier demos.

Anya: Action items: 1) create guarded repro set (Devon) 2) infra deploy flags & batch knobs (Lee) 3) canary + KPI dashboard (Sara) 4) doc short writeup for GTM with expected savings (Tom). I'll draft the short handoff doc after we have repro set.

Lee: ack on infra tasks, will add deploy flag and disable burst by default. :thumbsup:

Devon: I'll assemble the 40-50 repro prompts from the failures and split by category (hallucination, extraction, style).

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout: model=13B-int6, scope=eng-dedicated, start=2024-06-05T14:00Z, canary_pct=2.

Anya: perfect. please ping me when the canary dashboard is up and when repro set is in the eval pipeline. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
